description: Keyword search over model and dataset records, with task, licence, size and format filters, when you have no exact name; returns ids and short summaries. Use when you need keyword or filtered catalog results without an exact model name. Example: {"q":"embedding","limit":5}. Reads records; does not change files.

commercial.description: True to require recorded permission for commercial use.

cursor.description: Page cursor returned by the previous read.

detail.description: Summary rows by default; full returns detailed rows. Large results include bounded previews and detail links.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned rows; use the stated bounds.

reviewStatus.description: review Status; value for this operation.

task.description: Exact catalog task label, or code, chat, pictures. For a broad capability such as reranking, use q without task; an exact task filter can exclude matches.

name: search_artifacts

anyOf.description: Full details when detail is full, or a separate service handoff.

title: Search artifacts
